text:
Elaine: Quick heads-up — I'm kicking off quant readiness for orca-7b-mix. Weights uploaded to s3://redwood/model-store/orca-7b-mix/v1. Need a short async check on tokenizer oddities, calib set, and AWQ vs GPTQ call. :eyes:

Mike: Thanks — quick q: tokenizer is SentencePiece with legacy unk mapping. On inference we saw off-by-one in "offsets" for some rolodex tokens. Can you paste the tokenizer config?

Elaine: Config snippet below (same in s3):
```json
{"tokenizer": "spm", "model_file": "s3://redwood/tokenizers/orca-7b-mix/spm.model", "add_bos": true, "unk_id": 3, "special_offsets_fix": true}
```
I flipped special_offsets_fix=true to patch the mapping used in earlier runs. That fixed the common truncation repro.

Samir: For calibration we should use a mixed-domain set — ~5k samples with 40% docs / 30% dialogs / 30% code. I've staged examples at s3://redwood/calib/orca-7b-mix/2026-03-10/5k.jsonl. Note: the token length distribution skews longer than our usual 512 cutoff, so batch/to sequence settings need to be tuned.

Ben: Ran a quick eval (smoke): FP32 baseline: ppl=12.1, exact-match micro=0.67. AWQ-4/32 gave ppl=12.6, em=0.65 (latency +18%). GPTQ-4/32 gave ppl=12.2, em=0.66 but quantization step is slower in our pipeline. TL;DR: AWQ saves more memory/latency but trades ~1-2% EM.

Rachel: My read — acceptable for hosted canary if we gate by downstream QA on high-value prompts. Request: add an FP8 *safety* gate (only enable FP8 after manual signoff). :thumbsup:

Elaine: Agreed. Proposal: canary AWQ by default, GPTQ fallback if metrics drop >1.5% EM on the calib set. FP8 disabled until signoff. Anyone object?

Mike: No objections. I want a quick code-review ping on the runtime patch for special_offsets_fix — assigning to @Mike for review.

Samir: I'll run a 10k extended calib overnight and post numbers. If anyone wants specific eval slices (safety, hallucination, math), call them out now.

Ben: Pinging infra: please reserve 2x A10s for canary window next Tue 03:00-06:00 UTC.

qa-bot: smoke tests queued — results will be posted in this thread (link: https://ci.internal/redwood/runs/5667). :gear:

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: 2026-03-11T03:00:00Z -> 2026-03-11T06:00:00Z, route=canary/awq, fallback=gptq. Admins: @Rachel, @Elaine.

Rachel: :eyes: I'll review the calib slices Ben/Samir produce. If AWQ numbers stay within the threshold, I greenlight canary.

Elaine: Thanks all — I'll follow up with the runtime PR link and the final calib CSV once Samir's run finishes.
